guide-how-to-choose-an-outbound-agency.question: How long should an outbound agency's minimum contract be?
guide-how-to-choose-an-outbound-agency.answer: Long enough to see a real result, short enough that you're not trapped if it doesn't work. A 3-month minimum is common in the industry and reasonable: it covers setup, a first real sending window, and enough data to judge performance. Anything requiring a 12-month commitment before you've seen a single result is worth questioning.

guide-how-to-choose-an-outbound-agency.question: What reply rate should I expect from a good outbound agency?
guide-how-to-choose-an-outbound-agency.answer: Ranges vary a lot by channel, industry, and how tightly the ICP is defined, which is exactly why you should ask for a range with context, not a single flattering number. Be more skeptical of an agency that can only produce one client's best month than one that shows you a realistic spread across accounts.

guide-how-to-choose-an-outbound-agency.question: Should an outbound agency give me strategy, or just execute?
guide-how-to-choose-an-outbound-agency.answer: Both, ideally. Pure execution without ICP or messaging strategy tends to produce volume without results. Pure strategy without hands-on execution just leaves you with a plan you still have to run. Ask directly who defines your ICP and messaging, and who's accountable for it if it's wrong.

guide-how-to-choose-an-outbound-agency.question: What's a red flag when evaluating an outbound agency?
guide-how-to-choose-an-outbound-agency.answer: Vague answers to specific questions. If an agency can't tell you plainly who owns your sequences and lists after the engagement ends, what their deliverability setup actually looks like, or what a bad month triggers on their end, that vagueness is the answer.

guide-how-to-choose-b2b-lead-generation-.question: What does a B2B lead generation agency in India do?
guide-how-to-choose-b2b-lead-generation-.answer: A B2B lead generation agency finds companies that match your ideal customer profile and starts sales conversations with them. In India the label covers four different businesses: data vendors, telecalling firms, performance marketing agencies and outbound agencies running cold email and LinkedIn. Confirm which one you are talking to before you compare prices.

guide-how-to-choose-b2b-lead-generation-.question: How is B2B lead generation priced in India?
guide-how-to-choose-b2b-lead-generation-.answer: Agencies in India price B2B lead generation in three ways: a monthly retainer, a fee per qualified meeting, or a fee per lead, often with setup costs for domains and tools, plus 18% GST. Compare them on cost per qualified meeting that actually happened, because a low per-lead price often hides poor lead quality.

guide-how-to-choose-b2b-lead-generation-.question: Is cold email legal in India?
guide-how-to-choose-b2b-lead-generation-.answer: Cold email to business contacts is legal in India, but personal data handling falls under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. Its rules were notified in November 2025 and most obligations apply from May 2027. Commercial calls and SMS fall under TRAI rules instead. Ask any agency for its written approach and get legal advice for large campaigns.

guide-how-to-choose-b2b-lead-generation-.question: How long before a lead generation agency books the first meeting?
guide-how-to-choose-b2b-lead-generation-.answer: Across Myntmore's managed accounts, campaigns go live within 18 days of onboarding, the first qualified conversations come in weeks three to four, and meeting volume becomes consistent after six to eight weeks. The setup weeks go to ICP definition, list building, domain warm-up and copy. An agency promising meetings in week one is usually skipping one of those steps.

guide-how-to-choose-b2b-lead-generation-.question: Should I pay per lead or pay a retainer?
guide-how-to-choose-b2b-lead-generation-.answer: Pay per lead suits you when you only want contacts and will run the outreach yourself. A retainer or per-meeting model suits you when you want the agency to run the whole system, because it rewards them for testing, fixing deliverability and improving copy instead of maximising the number of contacts delivered.

lp-fundraising.question: Do you get us warm intros, or is this cold outreach?
lp-fundraising.answer: It's targeted, personalised outreach, not a guaranteed warm-intro service through mutual connections. What makes it feel warmer than a generic cold email is the specificity: we reference the fund's actual thesis, stage focus, and recent portfolio in every message, so it reads as informed outreach, not spray-and-pray.

lp-fundraising.question: How is this different from buying a Crunchbase or PitchBook list myself?
lp-fundraising.answer: A raw database gives you names and firms. It doesn't tell you which partner is actively deploying right now, whether your check size and stage actually fit their fund, or how to personalise the first message so it doesn't read like every other founder's cold email. We build the filtered list and run the full outreach system around it.

lp-fundraising.question: Do you help with the pitch deck or the fundraising narrative?
lp-fundraising.answer: No. Our focus is investor targeting and outreach, getting the right conversations booked, not deck design or narrative coaching. Bring a raise-ready story and we'll get it in front of the right investors.

lp-fundraising.question: What if I don't know exactly which investors are the right fit yet?
lp-fundraising.answer: That's the first step, not a prerequisite. We build your investor ICP with you, based on stage, sector, geography, and check size, before any outreach goes out.

lp-fundraising.question: Is this only for a specific funding stage?
lp-fundraising.answer: We've built this to flex from pre-seed and seed through Series A and B. The investor targeting criteria change with your stage; the underlying system doesn't.

lp-fundraising.question: How fast can this be live?
lp-fundraising.answer: Within 18 days, the same as our other outbound engagements. That covers the investor ICP, fund lists, sending domains and warm-up, and copy tailored to each fund's thesis. Fundraising timelines move fast, so we start the setup the day you sign.

lp-insurance.question: How is this different from cold calling or relying on referrals?
lp-insurance.answer: Cold calling is unstructured and low-conversion; referrals are unpredictable and capped by who you already know. We build a systematic, targeted outreach engine, verified decision-maker lists, credibility-led messaging, and renewal-timed sequencing, so new corporate conversations happen every month, not just when someone happens to refer you.

lp-insurance.question: How do you handle renewal-cycle timing?
lp-insurance.answer: We map each target company's likely renewal window and sequence outreach to land 60 to 90 days ahead of it, when they are actually evaluating alternatives. Outreach outside that window is deprioritised so we are not wasting your time on companies who are not listening yet.

lp-insurance.question: Does this work for group health insurance as well as commercial or property lines?
lp-insurance.answer: Yes. The system adapts to your specific book, group health, commercial property and liability, or keyman and corporate liability cover, by adjusting the ICP, the decision-makers we target, and the messaging to match how that line is actually bought.

lp-insurance.question: We already have a BD or relationship management team. Will this overlap?
lp-insurance.answer: No. We focus purely on generating net-new outbound conversations with companies you do not already have a relationship with. Your BD and RM teams keep managing existing accounts and referral relationships; we add a new, always-on channel for fresh corporate business.

lp-insurance.question: How soon can we expect our first meetings?
lp-insurance.answer: Most brokerage clients see their first qualified conversations within 3 to 4 weeks, once ICP mapping, decision-maker list building, and renewal-timed sequencing are in place.

lp-insurance.question: What does pricing and commitment look like?
lp-insurance.answer: We work on a monthly retainer with a 3-month minimum, which covers setup and enough sending to judge results. After that it runs month to month with 30 days' notice, with no annual contract. To be clear, we generate qualified buyer conversations only, we do not advise on policy structuring, underwriting, or claims.

lp-manufacturers-exporters.question: Do you work with our specific product category?
lp-manufacturers-exporters.answer: We have run campaigns across auto components, textiles, industrial equipment, and other manufacturing categories. During onboarding we map your product to the right buyer profile in your target markets.

lp-manufacturers-exporters.question: How do you make sure buyers are serious and not just price shopping?
lp-manufacturers-exporters.answer: We target named procurement heads, sourcing managers, and importers directly, based on company size and buying signals, instead of broadcasting to anyone who fills a form on a B2B portal.

lp-manufacturers-exporters.question: Which countries and regions can you target?
lp-manufacturers-exporters.answer: We have run outreach across Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Southeast Asia. Tell us your target markets and we build the prospect list and messaging around them.

lp-manufacturers-exporters.question: Do you handle the language and cultural side of outreach in different markets?
lp-manufacturers-exporters.answer: Yes. Messaging tone and structure are adjusted per region, and we can localise outreach where needed so it reads naturally to buyers in that market.

lp-manufacturers-exporters.question: What does pricing and commitment look like?
lp-manufacturers-exporters.answer: We work on a monthly retainer with a 3-month minimum, which covers setup and enough sending to judge results. After that it runs month to month with 30 days' notice, with no annual contract.

lp-manufacturers-exporters.question: What happens once we get an interested buyer? Do you help close the deal?
lp-manufacturers-exporters.answer: We hand over every qualified meeting with full context on the buyer and their requirements, so your team can focus entirely on the relationship and the close.

lp-pharma.question: Does Myntmore handle regulatory approvals or compliance for us?
lp-pharma.answer: No. Myntmore is a B2B outbound lead generation partner, we find and book meetings with the right buyers. Regulatory approvals, WHO-GMP or USFDA certification processes, and import-export compliance are handled entirely by your own regulatory, quality, and compliance team. We do not advise on or claim expertise in these areas.

lp-pharma.question: How does outreach differ for domestic buyers versus export and global buyers?
lp-pharma.answer: Domestic outreach targets hospital purchase committees, distributors, and chemist chains, with messaging built around tender cycles and regional buying patterns. Export and contract-manufacturing outreach targets importers, sourcing heads, and procurement teams abroad, with messaging built around therapeutic category fit and manufacturing capacity. We run both as separate, tailored tracks.

lp-pharma.question: How do you handle compliance-sensitive messaging in outreach?
lp-pharma.answer: We reference certifications and manufacturing capability factually, what you hold and what your facility supports, without making regulatory claims on your behalf. Any compliance-specific questions a buyer raises are flagged and routed straight to your team.

lp-pharma.question: Which buyer titles and roles do you typically target?
lp-pharma.answer: Procurement Heads, Regulatory Affairs contacts, Import/Export Managers, hospital Purchase Committee members, and Distribution Partners, depending on whether the target account is domestic or export focused.

lp-pharma.question: How fast will we start seeing meetings?
lp-pharma.answer: Most pharma clients see their first qualified buyer conversations within 3 to 5 weeks, once ICP mapping, list building, and outreach sequences are in place.

lp-pharma.question: What does pricing and commitment look like?
lp-pharma.answer: We work on a monthly retainer with a 3-month minimum, which covers setup and enough sending to judge results. After that it runs month to month with 30 days' notice, with no annual contract.

lp-recruitment-firms.question: How is this different from job boards and referrals?
lp-recruitment-firms.answer: Job boards and referrals are reactive, you wait for someone to post a role or a contact to think of you. We run proactive outbound to HR Heads and TA Leads at companies showing real hiring signals, so you are in front of decision-makers before they even post the job.

lp-recruitment-firms.question: We already have a business development person. Will this overlap?
lp-recruitment-firms.answer: No. We plug into your existing motion and focus purely on ABM style cold email and LinkedIn outreach to net new client companies. Your BD person keeps managing relationships and closing, we add the top of funnel volume they do not have time to generate.

lp-recruitment-firms.question: Does this integrate with our ATS or CRM?
lp-recruitment-firms.answer: We don't build or manage ATS or CRM integrations, whether that's Bullhorn, Zoho Recruit, or anything else, that stays part of your own process. Every qualified meeting and reply is handed off to your team directly, so it's easy to log wherever you already track pipeline.

lp-recruitment-firms.question: How fast will we start seeing meetings?
lp-recruitment-firms.answer: Most staffing clients see their first qualified client conversations within the first 3 to 4 weeks, once ICP mapping, list building, and sequence setup are complete.

lp-recruitment-firms.question: What does pricing and commitment look like?
lp-recruitment-firms.answer: We work on a monthly retainer with a 3-month minimum, which covers setup and enough sending to judge results. After that it runs month to month with 30 days' notice, with no annual contract.

lp-recruitment-firms.question: What if the leads are not a good fit for our specialisation?
lp-recruitment-firms.answer: We refine your ICP together in the first two weeks, narrowing by industry, role type, and company size, and keep adjusting targeting based on who books calls and who converts, so fit improves fast.

lp-saas-founders.question: How is this different from tools like Apollo or Clay that we already use?
lp-saas-founders.answer: Those tools give you data. We give you a fully managed system, ICP mapping, signal based targeting, copywriting, sequencing, and deliverability, run by a team that adjusts it every week based on what is working.

lp-saas-founders.question: Will this work if we are still pre-product-market fit?
lp-saas-founders.answer: Outbound works best once you have a handful of paying customers and a clear picture of who gets value fastest. If you are very early, we will tell you honestly and suggest starting with a smaller pilot.

lp-saas-founders.question: How do you avoid spam filters and protect our sender reputation?
lp-saas-founders.answer: We set up dedicated sending infrastructure, warm it up properly, and follow strict sending limits and personalisation practices, so your core domain reputation stays protected.

lp-saas-founders.question: Do you integrate with our CRM, like HubSpot or Salesforce?
lp-saas-founders.answer: We don't build or manage CRM integrations, that stays part of your own process. Every qualified reply and booked demo is handed off to your team directly, with full context from the conversation, so it's easy to log wherever you already track pipeline.

lp-saas-founders.question: What does pricing and commitment look like?
lp-saas-founders.answer: We work on a monthly retainer with a 3-month minimum, which covers setup and enough sending to judge results. After that it runs month to month with 30 days' notice, with no annual contract.

lp-saas-founders.question: We already tried outbound once and it did not work. Why would this be different?
lp-saas-founders.answer: Most failed outbound comes down to generic targeting and copy that reads like everyone else's. We rebuild it around specific buying signals and messaging tailored to your product, and iterate weekly instead of setting it and walking away.

service-account-based-marketing.question: How is this different from your other lead generation services?
service-account-based-marketing.answer: Our other services (cold email, LinkedIn outreach, AI lead gen) are built to generate volume across a broad ICP. ABM flips that: you give us a defined, finite list of named accounts you specifically want to win, and we run coordinated campaigns to engage multiple people inside each one, not just cast a wide net.

service-account-based-marketing.question: How many accounts can this realistically cover?
service-account-based-marketing.answer: Most engagements run 50 to 250 named accounts, tiered by priority. Tier 1 accounts (your highest-value targets) get the most coordinated, multi-stakeholder attention; lower tiers run on a lighter cadence. The right number depends on your team's capacity to follow up once accounts start engaging.

service-account-based-marketing.question: Which channels are included?
service-account-based-marketing.answer: LinkedIn outreach and email are the core channels, run in a coordinated sequence against the same account list rather than as separate campaigns. Where it fits your budget and audience, we can layer in LinkedIn ad retargeting for additional account-level visibility.

service-account-based-marketing.question: How does the handoff to our sales team actually work?
service-account-based-marketing.answer: Every account gets an engagement record: who was contacted, on which channel, what they opened or replied to, and how engaged the account is overall. That's delivered to your team as an account-level report, so your AE walks into the first conversation already knowing which stakeholders are warm and why.

service-account-based-marketing.question: What size company or deal size is this built for?
service-account-based-marketing.answer: ABM makes the most sense once your average deal size and sales cycle justify a multi-touch, multi-stakeholder approach, typically mid-market and enterprise B2B deals with several decision-makers involved. For simpler, single-stakeholder sales motions, our LinkedIn outreach or cold email services are usually a better fit.

service-ai-lead-generation.question: What does the AI actually do versus your human team?
service-ai-lead-generation.answer: The AI handles research, enrichment, and scoring at scale: pulling data from multiple sources, cross-referencing signals, and ranking leads by fit and intent. Our human team configures the agents, audits output for quality, writes the strategic layer, and makes sure nothing reaches your sales team without being genuinely useful.

service-ai-lead-generation.question: How accurate is the lead scoring?
service-ai-lead-generation.answer: With a well-defined ICP, our scoring model runs at roughly 85–90% relevance on the top tier. We build in a feedback loop: your team flags false positives and the model adjusts over time. Accuracy compounds month over month.

service-ai-lead-generation.question: How do we receive the leads?
service-ai-lead-generation.answer: You get clean, structured lead exports with full research summaries attached, mapped to your fields and ready to import into whatever system your team already uses. We don't build or manage CRM integrations, that stays part of your own process.

service-ai-lead-generation.question: How many leads can you generate per month?
service-ai-lead-generation.answer: For most B2B clients with a defined ICP we deliver 300 to 1,500 scored, research-enriched leads per month. Volume is never the goal. Relevance is. 200 right-fit leads beat 2,000 cold ones every time.

service-ai-lead-generation.question: Will this work for a niche industry with a small TAM?
service-ai-lead-generation.answer: Often better than broad markets. A smaller TAM means we go deeper on each account, track more specific signals, and personalise outreach at a level generic tools can't. Some of our best results come from clients with a TAM under 5,000 accounts.

service-cold-email.question: How does this work?
service-cold-email.answer: We run cold email end to end in ten steps. First we map your ideal customer profile and build a targeted lead list, then write the copy and set up domains, inboxes and DNS. After launch we handle follow-ups, A/B testing, nurturing replies into meetings, and real-time reporting.

service-cold-email.question: How do we measure success?
service-cold-email.answer: We measure four things: deliverability, reply rates, meetings booked and conversions. You get real-time tracking and regular reports, so you always see what is working. The targets we aim for are 90%+ email health, a 1%+ reply rate and 20%+ positive replies.

service-cold-email.question: What's the timeline?
service-cold-email.answer: Campaigns go live within 18 days of onboarding. That window covers domain and inbox setup, warm-up, building your lead list and writing the copy. First qualified conversations usually come in weeks 3 to 4, and meeting volume becomes consistent by weeks 6 to 8 as we optimise.

service-cold-email.question: Who sees the best results?
service-cold-email.answer: B2B businesses see the best results, particularly service providers, SaaS companies, agencies and consultants. These teams sell to a clearly defined set of business buyers, so a targeted list with every prospect handpicked, plus relevant soft-sell copy, starts conversations with exactly the right people.

service-cold-email.question: How many leads can I expect?
service-cold-email.answer: Clients typically see 1–3% reply rates, with consistent meetings by weeks 6 to 8. Volume depends on your list and offer: the package sends up to 1,200 emails a day to 5,000 fresh prospects a month, and results improve as we test copy and targeting. Some campaigns convert at 4x the industry average.

service-do-it-yourself.question: How is this different from your Done-for-You LinkedIn Outreach service?
service-do-it-yourself.answer: Done-for-You means our team builds and manages your entire LinkedIn outreach strategy, copy, and execution for you. Do It Yourself is the same underlying automation, but you're in the driver's seat: you log in with your own LinkedIn account, build your own campaigns, write your own notes and follow-ups, and run it yourself from your own dashboard.

service-do-it-yourself.question: Whose LinkedIn account does this run on?
service-do-it-yourself.answer: Yours. You log in with your own LinkedIn account, and every campaign you build runs from that account. Nothing is handed over to us.

service-do-it-yourself.question: Can I run more than one campaign?
service-do-it-yourself.answer: Yes. Each campaign has its own list of leads, connection note, and follow-up sequence, so you can run as many as you need at once, for different segments, offers, or lists.

service-do-it-yourself.question: What can I configure for my follow-ups?
service-do-it-yourself.answer: For every campaign, you set how many follow-up messages go out, what each one says, and the time delay before each one is sent.

service-do-it-yourself.question: What do I see on my dashboard?
service-do-it-yourself.answer: Both campaign-level and lifetime metrics: acceptance rate, reply rate, and the live status of every lead in every campaign.

service-do-it-yourself.question: How do I get access?
service-do-it-yourself.answer: Book a demo with our team and we'll get you set up.

service-gtm-strategy.question: What exactly is included in a GTM strategy engagement?
service-gtm-strategy.answer: ICP definition, competitive and market mapping, a channel mix and sequencing plan, a messaging framework, and a direct handoff to execution across whichever channels fit, cold email, LinkedIn, ABM, or personal branding. It's a plan built to be run, not a deck.

service-gtm-strategy.question: Do you also execute the strategy, or just hand over a plan?
service-gtm-strategy.answer: Both. The same team that builds the GTM strategy runs it across the channels you choose, so there's no handoff gap between "strategy" and "execution" like there is when a consultant hands a plan to a separate agency and disappears.

service-gtm-strategy.question: How is this different from your other services, like Cold Email or LinkedIn Outreach?
service-gtm-strategy.answer: Those are channel-specific execution services. GTM Strategy is the layer above them: it decides which channels to prioritise, what your ICP and messaging should be, and how they should sequence together, then feeds directly into whichever of those services you need.

service-gtm-strategy.question: How long does the initial strategy phase take?
service-gtm-strategy.answer: Typically 2-3 weeks for the audit, ICP work, and channel mix plan, the same timeline discipline we apply across our outbound engagements, where the average time to a first real result is around 18 days.

service-gtm-strategy.question: What if we already have a GTM strategy but it's not working?
service-gtm-strategy.answer: That's a common starting point, not a blocker. We audit what's already running, channels, messaging, and results, find where the current plan is leaking, and rebuild the parts that need it rather than starting from zero everywhere.

service-gtm-strategy.question: Is this only for early-stage startups?
service-gtm-strategy.answer: No. It fits any B2B company changing its GTM: a new ICP, a new market, a stalled channel, or scaling what's already working. Stage changes the specifics of the plan, not the process we use to build it.

service-linkedin-outreach.question: Why do I need to build a personal brand?
service-linkedin-outreach.answer: People buy from people they recognise and trust. A strong personal brand puts you in front of buyers before your first message, makes your outreach credible and gives you pricing power: 45% of a company's market value ties back to leadership reputation, and buyers pay 13.57x more to those they see as experts.

service-linkedin-outreach.question: Why LinkedIn?
service-linkedin-outreach.answer: LinkedIn is where you can reach named decision-makers directly, and personal profiles get 561% more reach than company pages. Content builds the trust, outreach starts the conversations, and both happen in the same place.

service-linkedin-outreach.question: What's in it for me?
service-linkedin-outreach.answer: A steady pipeline of conversations and qualified meetings, a profile and content that make your outreach credible, and a calendar that fills consistently, all for about 90 minutes of your time a month.

service-linkedin-outreach.question: How do AI agents fit into the process?
service-linkedin-outreach.answer: They work like a silent growth team, 24/7. They break down your ICP, rank who is most likely to engage, enrich every lead with context, track your competitors, and draft comments, replies and follow-ups that sound like you.

service-linkedin-outreach.question: What makes AI agents so effective for LinkedIn?
service-linkedin-outreach.answer: LinkedIn rewards relevance. Agents work from real-time data, so every connection request, InMail and follow-up reaches the right person with the right context, at a volume no human team can match, while we keep the voice yours.

service-linkedin-outreach.question: How much time do I need to spend as a founder?
service-linkedin-outreach.answer: About 90 minutes a month. We handle the research, content writing, outreach, replies to comments and reporting around that input, so your time goes into the conversations and meetings the work produces rather than into producing content or chasing leads.

service-linkedin-outreach.question: How does Myntmore help me stand out from the competition?
service-linkedin-outreach.answer: We track how often your competitors post, what works for them and where they fall short, then position you one step ahead with sharper messaging and content that gets you seen by the right people.

service-linkedin-outreach.question: What makes Myntmore different from other agencies?
service-linkedin-outreach.answer: Most agencies stop at profile optimisation, content and reporting. We also do ICP research, LinkedIn and InMail lead generation, multi-channel sequences, personalised connection requests, competitor and buyer intelligence, AI agent-led prospecting, weekly pipeline updates and monthly strategy reviews.

service-linkedin-outreach.question: How soon will I see results?
service-linkedin-outreach.answer: You won't get an explosion of leads on day one. The first weeks go into the right setup, the right audience and consistent content that builds trust. Traction builds from there as your content and outreach start working together.

service-linkedin-outreach.question: I might not have enough content to share. How will you generate that?
service-linkedin-outreach.answer: That is our job. We run a monthly content strategy, write the posts and use a short video interview with you to capture your ideas, so you never need a backlog of content.

service-overview.question: What B2B lead generation services do you offer?
service-overview.answer: We offer seven core services: LinkedIn Outreach and Automation, Cold Email Infrastructure, ICP Mapping and Lead Scoring, AI-Led Lead Generation, Account-Based Marketing, Personal Branding, and GTM Strategy. Each service is productized and runs on proven systems.

service-overview.question: How is AI used in your lead generation services?
service-overview.answer: Our AI agents research, qualify, and prioritize leads at scale, cutting manual research time by 80%. We also use AI for personalization in cold email and LinkedIn sequences, ensuring every outreach feels human and relevant.

service-overview.question: Do you work with B2B companies outside Mumbai?
service-overview.answer: Yes. While we are based in Mumbai, we serve B2B companies across India and internationally. Our systems work remotely and integrate with your existing tools.

service-personal-branding.question: Do I have to write anything myself?
service-personal-branding.answer: No. You give us one voice interview a month, about 45 minutes, and we write everything from there. You review and approve every post before it's published, so it always sounds like you, but you're not staring at a blank cursor.

service-personal-branding.question: How is this different from just posting more often?
service-personal-branding.answer: Posting more without a strategy usually means posting generic advice that blends in. We build your positioning first, what makes you specifically worth following, then write content that reinforces that angle every time, so followers build a consistent picture of who you are.

service-personal-branding.question: How many posts do I actually get?
service-personal-branding.answer: 4 to 8 fully ghostwritten LinkedIn posts a month, depending on the plan. Each one goes through your review and approval before it's scheduled.

service-personal-branding.question: Can this work alongside outbound, cold email or LinkedIn outreach?
service-personal-branding.answer: It's one of the strongest combinations we run. A prospect who's already seen your name and content reacts very differently to a cold email or connection request than someone who's never heard of you. Personal branding warms up the exact people your outbound is trying to reach.

service-personal-branding.question: How long before I see real results?
service-personal-branding.answer: Profile visits and engagement usually climb within the first month. Inbound messages referencing your content typically start by month two to three, since authority builds with consistency, not a single viral post.

service-sales-intelligence.question: What kinds of signals do you track?
service-sales-intelligence.answer: We track 40+ signal types across five categories: funding events, hiring activity, technology changes, competitive displacement, and behavioural triggers like content engagement and job posting language. The signals we prioritise for each client depend on what has historically correlated with a buying decision in your specific market.

service-sales-intelligence.question: How is this different from a bought list?
service-sales-intelligence.answer: A bought list gives you names and job titles: no context, no timing, no indication of intent. Signal-led intelligence gives you accounts that are actively showing buying behaviour right now. You know why they're on the list, what triggered them, and exactly what to say in your first message to make it land.

service-sales-intelligence.question: How often is the data refreshed?
service-sales-intelligence.answer: The signal feed refreshes daily. Accounts that hit your trigger criteria this week appear in your signal dashboard by the next morning. This is the core advantage over static lists: you're always working with the freshest possible view of who is in-market.

service-sales-intelligence.question: How do we receive the accounts?
service-sales-intelligence.answer: You get exportable account lists with full signal context attached, mapped to your fields and ready to import into whatever system your team already uses. We don't build or manage CRM integrations, that stays part of your own process.

service-sales-intelligence.question: What's the typical pipeline impact?
service-sales-intelligence.answer: Clients who switch from bought lists to signal-led outreach typically see 3–5x improvement in pipeline conversion within 90 days. The exact number depends on how well-defined your ICP is and how quickly your team adopts signal-triggered outreach. We build in a calibration period of 30 days to tune the scoring model to your market.

tool-linkedin-hook-grader.question: What is a LinkedIn hook?
tool-linkedin-hook-grader.answer: The first two lines of a LinkedIn post, the part shown before the "see more" cut. How much shows depends on the device, usually two to three lines. For many readers, those lines decide whether the rest gets read.

tool-linkedin-hook-grader.question: How is the score calculated?
tool-linkedin-hook-grader.answer: Six rules are checked in code: length, curiosity, specificity, authority, action and a clickbait penalty. They add up to 100. The same wording always gets the same score, and the AI never sets it.

tool-linkedin-hook-grader.question: What does the AI do?
tool-linkedin-hook-grader.answer: Google's Gemini writes three alternative hooks, each from a different angle: a specific result, a contrarian take and a curiosity gap. Each alternative is then scored with the same six rules, so you can compare them with your original.

tool-linkedin-hook-grader.question: Will it make up numbers for my hook?
tool-linkedin-hook-grader.answer: No. The rewrites keep your meaning and facts. Where a number would help and you gave none, the tool uses a placeholder such as [X%] for you to fill in with something true.

tool-linkedin-hook-grader.question: Is a high score a guarantee the post will perform?
tool-linkedin-hook-grader.answer: No. The score tells you how well the opening follows common hook principles. Reach also depends on your audience, topic, timing and the rest of the post. Use the score to compare versions, not to predict results.
